cmd: {"op": "jsawait", "expr": "(()=>{const n=[...document.querySelectorAll(\".map-node\")].find(x=>x.innerText.includes(\"Entry Hall\")); const r=n.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx=r.x+r.width/2, cy=r.y+r.height/2; const top=document.elementFromPoint(cx,cy); return JSON.stringify({cx,cy,top:top.tagName+\".\"+top.className, contains:n.contains(top)})})()"}
